caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a woman standing on a rectangular wooden platform. She has medium brown skin and long, dark hair that falls down her back and is mostly covered by a green and yellow cap with blue vertical stripes. She wears a knee-length dress that is predominantly yellow with green short sleeves and green panels along the sides and hem, adorned with a pattern of yellow dots and a scalloped edge. The dress features a large red heart shape outlined in blue on the chest area, and additional blue and green trim along the hem and waist. She has a necklace, large round earrings, and yellow shoes with matching green, pointed toe caps. In her right hand, she is holding up a green cylindrical object, possibly a cup or container, while her left hand holds a leafy green bundle, suggesting vegetables or foliage. The background is a plain off-white color, and there are no additional objects or scenery in the composition.
